description: Aster is a practice management platform for women's health clinics
long_description: Aster’s technology enables women’s health practices to manage, grow and scale their practices. Their software improves clinical outcomes and enables practices to remain competitive and independent in the ever-changing landscape of healthcare.

description: Bright is an AI-powered immersive training platform for the workforce
long_description: Bright is a full-suite immersive training platform that delivers practice-focused experiences at scale, including AI-powered conversation simulation, software simulation, VR, and coaching.

description: Personalized, virtual nutrition care from experts you can trust
long_description: Culina Health is democratizing access to insurance-reimbursed clinical nutrition sessions with our registered dietitians. We are bridging the gap with the 300M people in the US that need access to a culturally competent and clinical trained dietitian. We treat, prevent and reverse patients’ health conditions, either directly or as part of care delivery teams — including specialities and hospitals.

description: Death Clock AI analyzes your life choices to determine when you will die
long_description: Death Clock AI analyzes your life choices to determine when you will die, and how you can improve your habits to live even longer.

description: EasyMate is simple tooling that help non-AI engineers deploy AI in their websites and apps
long_description: Create powerful web and mobile applications for your business in minutes. Just chat and watch your ideas come to life.

description: Eli Health is a saliva test for the continuous monitoring of hormones
long_description: Eli is a women's health company on a mission to improve lifelong health through continuous hormone monitoring. With just three simple steps, Eli's at-home technology provides women with personalized hormone profiles to make informed decisions about their health in key areas like menopause, fertility, contraception, and endocrine conditions. Eli offers real-time insights from hormones in saliva that can be tracked continuously over time, unlike traditional testing methods or send-out tests that only provide a single snapshot.

long_description: Frame partners with OB/GYNs, fertility clinics, and primary care teams to deliver virtual care, coaching, and help navigating every stage of the family building journey

long_description: Guaranteed reimagines end-of-life healthcare with technology that allows clinicians to put the patients first. ‍

long_description: Joshin is an employee benefit and comprehensive support system for disability and neurodivergence. We guide and support companies, employees, and their families in all aspects of disability and neurodivergence through specialized care, virtual coaching, and disability education.

description: A wearable ring that controls objects at home by pointing

description: TenYour is insurtech for middle-class professionals starting with unemployment protection for American workers
long_description: Our mission is to provide a tenure track for generational wealth for the middle class. We believe a career is about more than funding your lifestyle, but your future. Your future should offer peace of mind, a satisfying retirement, and an opportunity to build and protect a legacy.
